name: Taqī al-Dīn Abū al-ʿAbbās Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad al-Shumunnī
summary: Ḥanafī scholar of Cairo, a teacher of al-Suyūṭī, whose al-Munṣif defends Ibn Hishām's Mughnī against al-Damāmīnī's criticisms.
bio: Al-Shumunnī was born in Alexandria in 801/1399, moved from the Mālikī to the Ḥanafī school, and taught in Cairo, where al-Suyūṭī read grammar with him and wrote of him with great respect. His al-Munṣif min al-kalām ʿalā Mughnī Ibn Hishām goes through al-Damāmīnī's objections to the Mughnī and answers them, so that the three books are read together. He died in Cairo in 872/1468.

works.title: al-Munṣif min al-kalām ʿalā Mughnī Ibn Hishām
